messages:
Marta (New Hire): Hey folks quick Qs before my first pay period:
1) I'm on a work visa — can I enroll my spouse as a dependent for benefits? Any special docs?
2) I submitted a moving receipt but not sure which expense category. I shipped boxes and paid a small courier fee.
3) For PTO, am I eligible for accrual during probation? My offer said '90 day provisional period'.

Ethan (People Ops): Welcome Marta! :wave: Short answers:
1) Yes you can enroll a spouse. We need a marriage certificate + spouse passport/ID + proof of address if available. For visa holders we also ask for a copy of your visa to confirm eligibility with the carrier. Upload via the benefits portal.
2) Courier/boxes -> use "Relocation - Misc" up to policy cap. If you used a commercial mover use "Relocation - Moving Expense". Include receipts + tracking numbers.
3) PTO accrues from day one in our system, but managers sometimes limit usage during the first 30 days. "90 day" probation rarely blocks accrual unless explicitly stated in the offer. DM me your offer if you want me to check.

Marta (New Hire): Thanks! For spouse docs: spouse is abroad and only has a passport, no local ID or utility bills. Will passport + marriage cert be enough?

Lina (Benefits): Passport + marriage certificate usually suffice. If we need proof of shared residence for certain plans we accept a signed affidavit + 1 supporting doc. Upload what you have and we'll handle vendor follow-up; translations may be requested.

Priya (Payroll): On the moving receipt: if you want it treated as a non-taxable reimbursement make sure it matches the relocation policy. Otherwise processed as stipend (taxed). Also reimbursements require your bank to be verified in ADP for direct deposit.

Marta (New Hire): ADP shows bank unverified. I did micro-deposits last night. Who should I ping if it doesn't verify?

Ethan (People Ops): Ping @Priya here and include the ADP ticket number. If verification fails in 48 hours we can do a manual ACH for the reimbursement.

Marta (New Hire): One more: I was told about a local holiday this month the San Francisco office observes. Do remote folks in other countries get it?

Lina (Benefits): Holidays are based on your work location. Remote employees follow the holiday calendar for the country listed on their HR profile. If you want that SF day off, request floating or PTO and ask your manager; managers can approve local exceptions.

Marta (New Hire): Great. I'll DM my manager. Uploading docs now; will ping if anything bounces. Thanks all :heart:

HR Bot: Reminder: dependent enrollment window is 30 days from benefits eligibility date. Missing documentation may delay carrier enrollment and they may request proof within 14 days.

Priya (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoff for reimbursements is 2025-02-28 18:00 PST. If your relocation posts after cutoff it will hit the next cycle.

Ethan (People Ops): Closing note: Marta, I checked your offer; no PTO hold noted. You accrue immediately. Welcome aboard! :tada:
